description: Real-time status and stop sequence for a trip. Returns vehicle position, schedule deviation, current phase, and remaining stops. Use tripId from onebusaway_get_arrivals to look up a specific vehicle's progress.

includeSchedule.description: Whether to include the full stop sequence with times. Defaults to true.

serviceDateMs.description: Service date as Unix milliseconds (midnight local time) — a non-negative integer. Only needed for trips from a previous service day. Omit to use today.

tripId.description: Trip ID from an arrivals response or schedule lookup.

name: onebusaway_get_trip

blockId.description: Block ID grouping this trip with the others the same vehicle runs back-to-back. Pass to onebusaway_get_block for the full block schedule. Null when the trip has no block.

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `trip_not_found`: Trip ID not found or not active for the service date. `rate_limited`: No upstream request slot opened within the queue wait cap, or OneBusAway returned a rate limit response. Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A scheduled stop time along this trip.

arrivalTime.description: Scheduled arrival time as seconds from midnight (GTFS format).

departureTime.description: Scheduled departure time as seconds from midnight (GTFS format).

distanceAlongTripMeters.description: Distance along the trip to this stop, in meters.

schedule.description: Full stop sequence with times, or null if includeSchedule=false.

situations.description: Active situation IDs affecting this trip.

closestStop.description: Stop ID of the closest stop, or null.

lastUpdateTime.description: Timestamp of the last real-time update as Unix milliseconds.

nextStop.description: Stop ID of the next stop, or null.

position.description: Current vehicle position if available, or null.

predicted.description: True if GPS-tracked real-time data is available.

vehicleId.description: Vehicle ID if known, or null.

timezone.description: Validated timezone of the trip route agency, or UTC when unavailable or invalid.

title: Get Trip Status
